note: Syscalls and minor page faults per opal command, above the empty static C program's. compare-runtimes.py gate fails CI when a command goes over; --rebase rewrites the numbers from a measurement plus headroom. Counts are for the whole process tree (strace -f), so a script's own shell is in them; the scripts here are `true` so that what moves is opal's part. `run hello.js` starts the JavaScript engine from its snapshot; its counts are what the runtime's startup costs above the floor.
